title: Is Power of Two
statement: Given an integer n, return true if n is a power of two (i.e. n = 2^k for some non-negative integer k), and false otherwise. n may be negative, zero, or positive. Solve it using a constant-time bit trick rather than looping or using logarithms.
hints: Think about what the binary representation of a power of two looks like compared to other numbers.
A power of two has exactly one bit set; subtracting 1 from it flips that bit and all bits below it (which there are none).
Check n > 0 and that n & (n - 1) equals 0, which is true only when n has a single set bit.
